svg.title: Spot the Bot — Maltese
svg.desc: Pipeline: corpus, hybrid lemmatiser, SVD dictionary, LSTM generator, n-gram clouds, then clustering and topology compared under a bootstrap.

ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: two independent methods over the same n-gram clouds
